PluginData.Author: Matelemons
PluginData.Tooltip: Alternative tonemapping curves for all displays, plus HDR10 output for HDR displays.
PluginData.Description:
Replaces SE2's Hable tonemapper with HDR-friendly alternatives (AgX, Uchimura GT).
If you have an HDR display, it also adds HDR10 output. AgX and Uchimura GT natively support HDR, and an extended Hable curve is also available. In HDR mode, the swapchains are made 10-bit, the Rec.709 colors are transformed to Rec.2020 and encoded with ST.2084 PQ.
Report issues at https://github.com/matelemons/SE2_HDR/issues
